system.description:
You are treated as having obtained "Assist Attack" at SR1. If you already have it, your "Assist Attack" [Accuracy Check] is increased by +1. [Trigger: Action] Use this at the same time as your "Assist Attack". Consume 1 point of [Fate] as a cost. If your "Assist Attack" is successful, you also inflict [Rigor] on the target. A whip named after the venomous serpent, a predator of the desert. It seems to have its own will, entangling enemies and taking away their freedom.

Broken Shaft [Core Material] (60G) + Neck Hanger (55G) + [Magic Catalyst 4] (30G) ×5 + Crafting Cost (115G)
